source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    To check BMC dedicate port location is normal.
1. Check dedicated port location on MB

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Dedicated Port location should be correct as system spec

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: Location check checks the physical location of the dedicate-port on the mainboard; that is a visual/mechanical inspection requiring a person at the machine (photo/blackbox evidence), which the agent cannot produce over SSH.

original_test_intent: Verify by physical inspection that the motherboard's dedicated BMC management connector is installed at the location defined for the exact platform and board revision.
original_method: An engineer identifies the board revision, compares the actual dedicated BMC port and surrounding landmarks with the approved motherboard drawing, and captures a clear location photo without changing the hardware configuration.
manual_activity: A qualified engineer must visually locate the physical connector on the motherboard, distinguish the dedicated BMC port from shared or adjacent RJ45 interfaces, compare it with the board drawing and capture the acceptance photo.
required_inputs: Approved motherboard layout or service drawing with the dedicated BMC port designator
Expected connector orientation and location landmarks
Safe chassis-access/ESD procedure and evidence destination
safety_requirements: Follow ESD and chassis-access controls; do not touch components solely for this inspection.
Do not disconnect an active management cable or alter port configuration to identify the connector.
Stop if the board revision, connector designator or dedicated-versus-shared identity is ambiguous; do not guess.
Preserve existing logs and configuration; no automatic retry is applicable.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the drawing-to-photo comparison checklist and evidence naming scheme.
Record read-only platform inventory or post-inspection BMC reachability when approved as supporting evidence.
Annotate and organize operator-supplied photographs without claiming the visual inspection was agent-executed.
engineer_actions: Confirm the exact board revision and authoritative port-location drawing.
Perform the physical inspection and photograph the connector with identifying landmarks.
Decide PASS/FAIL after comparing actual location with the specification.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: no remote command can prove the connector's physical motherboard location.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Do not substitute a network scan, BMC ping or interface enumeration for the physical-location inspection. Such checks may only corroborate reachability after the operator inspection.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The physical location check, photo/result collection and 1/0-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the revision-controlled board drawing, photograph the connector and at least two stable board landmarks, and annotate the image with the connector designator and revision. Optionally record unchanged BMC reachability if cabling was present.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact motherboard revision under review.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record drawing revision plus BIOS/BMC inventory for traceability; no software version changes the physical criterion.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner-approved motherboard layout, mechanical drawing or service manual.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds revision and landmark traceability without replacing the visual check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; network functionality remains outside this location-only case.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A photo without revision or surrounding landmarks can misidentify a shared or adjacent connector.

project_override_considerations: A project may define its exact board drawing, photo angle and connector landmarks. It may not replace the location criterion with successful BMC connectivity. Missing project drawing is an execution-readiness gap rather than a permanent BLOCKED classification.
expected_evidence: SUT identity, motherboard revision and approved drawing revision
Timestamped annotated photo showing the dedicated BMC connector, designator and surrounding landmarks
Statement that no cable, power or configuration was changed
Separate engineer comparison and PASS/FAIL verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item, procedure and criterion consistently require a physical dedicated-port location comparison against the system specification.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The required physical inspection is clear. Missing board-specific references or access make a planned execution not ready, but do not make the library case permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree that the physical/visual core is not agent-executable.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and retain its board-revision, port-identity and ESD boundaries.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates physical-location acceptance from optional reachability evidence and treats missing project references as readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Defines the minimum drawing and photographic landmarks needed to prevent a nearby shared RJ45 connector from being accepted as the dedicated BMC port.
independent_technical_reasoning: This case accepts a mechanical placement fact, not network behavior. Connector enumeration can show an interface exists but cannot prove where it is installed, so the core remains MANUAL ONLY and the engineer owns the visual verdict.
